title: Quasi-isomorphism detection on a principal-open cover of an affine open
statement: Let X be affine [def-pc-scheme], U an open, A=Gamma(X,O_X), and choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of structure-sheaf modules on X and on U in the same morphism universe. Let T from A-modules to structure-sheaf modules on X preserve zero morphisms and be naturally isomorphic to tilde followed by restriction along X.isoSpec.hom. Let f_j be a finite family with D(f_j) contained in U and covering U. For any A-module complexes F,M and chain map alpha:F to M, if every localized map alpha_fj is a quasi-isomorphism, then the derived restriction to U of Q(T alpha) is invertible. There are no pseudo-coherence, boundedness, compactness, or unit-ideal hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 08EE (lemma-lift-pseudo-coherent), affine module-model and final sheafification steps; Tag 08E7 for local pseudo-coherence

proof.text: Tilde is a left adjoint and preserves colimits. Its map on local representatives of a section is IsLocalizedModule.map at the prime complement. IsLocalizedModule.map_injective therefore shows that tilde preserves monomorphisms. Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesMonos_and_cokernels proves preservation of homology. This is the fully proved private tilde_preservesHomology helper; it needs no quasi-coherent-kernel theorem.

For one a in A, let j be Spec(A_a) -> Spec(A) and p=j followed by X.isoSpec.inv. Equality of the open-immersion ranges explicitly constructs an isomorphism Spec(A_a) ≅ D(a). Unpack this constructed isomorphism together with its inverse factorization to keep subsequent transport independent of its implementation. The source-library Scheme.Modules.tildePullbackIso identifies tilde followed by pullback along j with scalar extension followed by tilde. It is proved by composing the affine tilde/Gamma adjunction with pullback/pushforward, identifying the common right adjoint by pushforwardSpecMapCompΓIso, and uniqueness of left adjoints. Open restriction is pullback, and restrictFunctorComp plus hT transport this natural comparison to T followed by restriction along p. Lift the comparison to complexes and use exactness of tilde on the supplied localized quasi-isomorphism. Restrict along the inverse of Spec(A_a) ≅ D(a) and use overFunctorEquiv to obtain the quasi-isomorphism of the over-site restricted T(alpha). Restriction is exact by preservation of limits and colimits. This is the fully proved private principalOpen_localized_quasiIso helper.

View the D(f_j) as the objects Over.mk(homOfLE(hsub j)) in the localized open site over U. For any object Z and x in Z, hcover gives a j; Z intersect D(f_j) is a covering neighbourhood of x with a map to the j-th object. This proves CoversTop, including the empty-index case. Apply Mathlib Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop to the underlying abelian sheaves of a module map restricted over U, then reflect isomorphisms with SheafOfModules.toSheaf. Apply this criterion to each ambient homology map of T(alpha). ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality identifies its local restrictions with homology of the locally restricted complexes. Consequently the map restricted over U is a quasi-isomorphism. The isIso_over_of_cover and quasiIso_over_of_cover helpers prove all these steps directly.

The open-scheme equivalence preserves homology and hence quasi-isomorphisms. Q sends the resulting quasi-isomorphism to an isomorphism. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors conjugates that morphism to the map asserted in the conclusion; cancellation of its invertible component proves IsIso. The statement and universes are unchanged, and no additional derived categories are chosen.

proof_origin.place: Final sheafification; shorter categorical comparison via the already proved Scheme.Modules.tildePullbackIso, and direct Mathlib sheaf local-isomorphism criterion. All private helpers fully proved.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_principal_cover_quasiIso_detection
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [T.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (hT : Nonempty (T ≅ tilde.functor (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) ⋙
      Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom))
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))
    (hsub : ∀ j, X.basicOpen (f j) ≤ U)
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U → ∃ j, x ∈ X.basicOpen (f j))
    (F M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))) ℤ) (α : F ⟶ M)
    (hα : ∀ j : Fin r, QuasiIso ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) (Localization.Away (f j))))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α)) :
    IsIso (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.map
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α)))
